topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This topic frames the lecture by welcoming students and introducing the learning outcomes on cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional Modalities and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover traditional cancer treatment modalities with an emphasis on the mechanisms, toxicities, and drug resistance associated with cytotoxic chemotherapy.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies designed to exploit inherent cellular vulnerabilities and DNA repair defects in cancer cells.

topics.label: Targeted Oncogene and Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeted therapies that inhibit oncogenic kinase pathways alongside the mechanisms driving acquired resistance.

topics.label: Antibody-Based Cancer Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the design and mechanisms of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor cell-surface antigens.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and Engineered Immune Approaches
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine concepts and methods for mobilizing the host immune system and engineering immune cells to target tumors.

topics.label: Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Treatment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate overarching clinical challenges, historical treatment progress, and emerging paradigms shaping the future of cancer care.
